note: The R1 robustness battery for J1b (P3e F19, unit W1-ROB). Read by pipeline/aws/r1/rob_jobs_r1.py (unit list), run_units.py (stacks) and rob_post_r1.py. Every value that October fixed is checked against its October source by tests/test_r1_robustness.py. Star-departure robustness (F20) is out of scope: author 2026-10-15, the paper prints no star-departure number.
group_note: No separate 'controls' group: each control runs in the same group as the cells that need it, so a control mismatch skips only its dependents (ruling R1P3-29) instead of failing a whole stage before any cell runs.

golds.note: J1a writes its estimates under the October gold basenames (config/r1/cells M.tsv out_name); the P3pos/P3med JSONs carry label P3cut_<spec>_<field>.

sources.perm_p1p2: config/seeds.yaml permutation_seed == analysis/robustness/inference/run_all_perm.sh SEED (prep_t5_batch.sh asserts the two agree)
sources.perm_p3: the October cloud kit's --perm-seed default (cloudkit.py A2: the 2026-08-30 batch grammar; tests/test_r1_robustness.py::test_seeds_and_grammar_come_from_config checks the two agree)
sources.null: the October cloud kit's --null-seed default (cloudkit.py A2; checked by the same test)

perm.sources: B/CHUNK/cells_p1p2 = run_all_perm.sh (B=${SAR_PERM_B:-500}, CHUNK=50, the p1/p2 rows of CELLS); chunk_p3 = cloudkit A2 (econ 5, others 50)

stacks.note: October ran the permutation and null units on the cloud R (cloud_t5, cloud batches) and every other robustness cell locally; J1a runs its P1/P2/P3-A_far cells under rmac, so the in-run controls compare like with like.

est_min.basis: October wall: T5 66 perm units in 27 min at 12 parallel (cloud_t5/fetch/progress.log); the P3 perm/null phase about 80 min at 12 parallel for 171 units; local P1/P2 cells 1-7 min (battery runlog); nocentre driver ~1 min per field on the Mac, x20 margin for the M chain

battery.source: analysis/robustness/battery_2026-08-29/run_all_battery.sh (T2 bounds x3, T3 levels x3, T4 never-exposed x3)

doublestar.note: the drop table and the report's per-field counts always cover all three fields; only the econ frames are built because only P1ds_econ (and its complement P1dsC_econ) is printed

nocentre.note: economics has no centre roster variant (run_nocentre.py:10-12); frames rebuilt by W2-CHEMM chemmath_m.py --roster-variant incfel

nocentre_build.cmd: bash -c 'unset SAR_SSD_ROOT; rm -rf "{tmp}/nocentre_scratch" && mkdir -p "{tmp}/nocentre_scratch" && export SAR_OUT_ROOT="{tmp}/nocentre_scratch" R_LIBS="$SAR_RLIB_RMAC" PATH="$(dirname "$SAR_RSCRIPT_RMAC"):$PATH" && "$PY" "{repo}/pipeline/aws/r1/edge_table.py" shadow --target /data/openalex_pipeline/derived/u1_full_11school_2026-07-16 --out "{work}/edge_table_rob" --base-paths "{repo}/config/r1/paths_aws.yaml" > "{tmp}/nocentre_edge_paths.txt" && export SAR_PATHS_CONFIG="$(tail -n 1 "{tmp}/nocentre_edge_paths.txt")" && test -f "$SAR_PATHS_CONFIG" && "$PY" "{bin}/chemmath_m.py" --mode m --config "{repo}/config/r1/M.json" --events-dir "{events}" --roster-chemistry "{roster_chemistry}" --roster-math-stats "{roster_math_stats}" --roster-variant incfel --stars-excluded-base "{stars_excluded_base}" --event-tables-all "{event_tables_all}" --calls "{calls}" --out "{out}" --fields chemistry,math_stats'
nocentre_build.note: The J1a frames_chemmath_m call (config/r1/stages/j1a.json) with the incfel rosters and --roster-variant incfel, in J1a's environment: run_units runs a unit without a shell, so the unit is one `bash -c` script that sets J1a's scratch root and R stack, builds (or reuses) the 11-school edge-table shadow from paths_aws.yaml exactly as J1a's row does and exports its paths file (chemmath_m.edge_env STOPs EDGE_ENV otherwise), then calls chemmath_m. Values: repo:<path> = the clone; {events} / {calls} = the restored J1a products /work/j1a/events and /work/j1a/calls (rob_jobs_r1.m_roots, j1a_layout); stars_excluded_base = the same 08-28 list J1a's row reads (M review #7).

forbidden_exempt.reason: rob_jobs_r1 STOPs any M unit naming data/frames or cal2026-08-28 (an October path left behind). The one exception is the 08-28 excluded-star list the no-centre rebuild starts its M stars_excluded list from, exactly as J1a's frames_chemmath_m does (read_allowlist_0828.txt: frames_econ920, frames_chemmath_m, rob_frames); only this exact path is removed before the scan (M review #7).

group_outputs.note: rob-root-relative paths each group writes (for the J1b stage output tokens); disjoint across groups. The post group's manifest unit also writes <top>/MANIFEST.sha256 into every top directory of the root (October's per-directory MANIFEST); those files are not listed because they sit inside other groups' directories.
